scope: Hindsight 0.9.1 custom to upstream 1.2.0: preserve existing Eva outcome and boundaries; no new framework, no product changes, no household/provider data export.

observations: Bank deletion fixes include LLM request history and maintenance queues; document deletion and derived data must still be independently checked.
Skipped consolidation retry can end cancelled with superseded_by; do not reinterpret as successful retain or proof all writers are settled.
ModelCallExtension can observe every model input/output; preserve disabled/unconfigured private telemetry and current provider routing.
New consolidation/index/shutdown fixes are potentially beneficial; preserve contracts rather than forcing old custom implementation.

criteria.original: Only later-useful knowledge, separate chat history, exact person/source/date/correction/forget, evidence-based cleanup with measured storage/context, no second memory or classification model per turn.

boundaries.name: identity-and-private-read
boundaries.required: Keep tenant/installation bank, principal/audience/project/observation partitions, current consent and linked-identity revocation. Retrieve source evidence before admission, including observations; provider tags alone are not authority. Fresh validation on cache hits, correction and erasure invalidation; no permissive SQL fallback on protocol errors.

boundaries.name: revision-and-idempotency
boundaries.required: Same exact bank/items/source revision reuses operation identity and durable result after lost ack/restart; changed source revision differs. Wrong/missing operation identity rejected. Retry only exact pre-existing failed operation once; pending/processing/cancelled/unknown not blindly replayed. Preserve operation/result/error evidence and disable native operation-row GC unless a proved durable replacement owns replay.

boundaries.name: dream-ack-before-compaction
boundaries.required: Persist exact immutable cohort+operation before POST; all actual children terminal, exact per-document source hash/metadata/tags/no raw original_text, explicit measured zero extraction errors and matching counts before acknowledgement. Missing/partial/unknown is not zero. GET-only receipt recovery before erasure, never replay to settle a possible writer.

boundaries.name: forget-and-stop
boundaries.required: Existing retention/erasure guard and durable lease serialize workers. Advance restore authority erasure generation before content deletion; exact target/person/source receipt. Remove document, derivative model and cache, preserve tombstones/proof. Refuse completion while any remote child can write. STOP/foreground/capacity prevent later background stages and no unmanaged reflection cron is introduced.

boundaries.name: database-schema
boundaries.required: Inventory exact native schema/version/extensions/indexes and Eva triggers/functions before migration. Upgrade on private consistent clone. Completed-payload SQL is 0.9.1/schema-specific; do not blindly transplant. Preserve equivalent bounded success-only compaction or explicitly measured no-compaction with no premature source deletion; no sweeping historical unknown/error rows. Preserve original sources, operation results/errors/IDs, bank settings, tags, mental models, observations and tombstones.

isolatedCanary: Bind exact live image/config/migrations/schema/custom-source/model settings and a private consistent database clone. Keep clone in root-private storage; isolated network/credentials prohibit household or new remote provider calls. Publish only counts/hash/boolean results; no source text.

First run migration and start/health against cloned data with automatic processing paused. Compare row identities/counts/hashes for retained historical operation/error/tombstone/source rows and current bank settings; distinguish intended schema transformations from data loss.

Use separate synthetic bank/person A+B and an explicitly controlled deterministic inference seam for structural canary: ordinary selected preference, unselected exchange, correction, typed work source; exact replay and lost-ack/restart; verify operation identity and actual extraction count. This tests protocol/state, not semantic model quality.

Exercise actual candidate service retention/recall with current approved local inference/provider route only when explicitly authorized: useful preference/correction, empty selection, source date, A/B privacy, current revoked consent, no raw text storage for dream; measure first/warm latency, usage/storage. If deterministic seam used, mark semantic live extraction unproven.

Test dream cohort interruption/partial ack and new unrelated member; restart recovery retains membership with no duplicate dispatch. Terminal parent plus pending/missing/failed child, unknown extraction counts, wrong hash/source/tag and cancelled/superseded status must never permit erase or source compaction.

Forget during pending retain stays leased/pending; settle via GET, then delete exactly scoped document+derived data and invalidate warmed recall. Restart and replay remain erased and do not resurrect facts from queued work/history/cache.

On candidate data create a fresh selected record, fresh correction, completed operation receipt and erasure tombstone AFTER migration; stop all writers and run old image on that SAME resulting database only after proved schema compatibility. Verify fresh records/receipts remain and erased data stays erased. If downgrade needs destructive schema/data restore, NO_GO automatic rollback; prepare reversible compatibility migration or reviewed forward fix before activation.

Activation later requires current all-claims/leases/model-assessments/memory-writers gate and post-stop gate, single dispatch receipt, exact image/config/environment/mount preservation and retained baseline. No blanket old-marker exclusions. Post-install authenticated source-bound recall/readback plus unchanged core/worker profiles where touched; no family-acceptance claim.
customOverlayDisposition: Classify each GC/warmup/reranker cache/parallel and payload-compaction patch against exact upstream1.2 implementation. Remove superseded pieces after behavior/resource/source-proof comparison; retaining every0.9.1 patch is not acceptance. Never bypass source pins to apply old patches on changed upstream.
unknowns: No live image or candidate clone inspected by this preparation reviewer.
No migration/downgrade compatibility claimed; sibling handles actual upstream migration inspection.
No new tests/model calls/installation performed; concrete bundle needs independent final review.
